audit.action: a better source should be cited for the same classification
audit.quote_check: confirmed in the copy we hold
audit.reasoning: Coding 'fixed-dominant, initial (initial stress)' matches the source exactly: primary stress on the first syllable in di-/polysyllables, with a restricted lexical set showing added secondary stress on the following syllable (primary still initial), so 'dominant' rather than 'strict' is a defensible conservative choice and no reclassification is indicated. The deciding source is the best available (2022 published sketch with spectrograms, by the main fieldworker), it is held in-tree (under bhot1235/src) and the quotation is verbatim at ch. 4 sec. 2.3 p. 284. Housekeeping only: populate the empty top-level quote/cite/loc/grade fields from sources[0] with locator 'Saxena 2022: ch. 4, sec. 2.3, p. 284 (also fn. *, p. 272); doi:10.1163/9789004513648_005', and register the copy we hold path for hari1246 (symlink or held-list entry pointing).
